summary.text: Jillaire McMillan is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Dan Woog (R).
A small business owner and former nonprofit leader, she was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jillaire McMillan was born in Delaware and earned a high school diploma from Viewmont High School and bachelor's and graduate degrees from Boston College in 2000 and 2001.
Her career experience includes running a small business and serving as the director of volunteers at a nonprofit.

In a Ballotpedia survey, McMillan said she moved to Colorado in 2016 with her husband and four children, spent eight years as a leader in a national nonpartisan organization, and co-founded a marine robotics company in 2019.
She said she was the Democratic nominee for House District 19 in 2024, stepping in when the incumbent dropped out, and lost by 110 votes.
She said her priorities include access to healthcare and reproductive care, and that she would engage across party lines.
